defects.float_truncation: to_cents uses int(amount * 100), so 0.29 becomes 28 cents and 19.99 becomes 1998 cents instead of rounding to the nearest cent.
defects.floor_page_count: page_count uses floor division, so 101 items at 50 per page gives 2 pages instead of 3.
defects.identity_has_more: page_slice compares len(chunk) with per_page using is, which is False for per_page 500, so has_more is False on a full first page of 1000 items.
defects.generator_consumed: summarize reads the events iterable once for the day totals and again for the count, so a generator yields events 0 and every day total 0.00.
defects.naive_timestamp_local: normalize_timestamp leaves timestamps without an offset naive, so their wall-clock time is read in the machine's local zone instead of UTC.
defects.dst_day_end: day_bounds ends each local day at its UTC start plus 24 hours, so on 2024-03-31 an event at 22:30 UTC (00:30 Paris on 2024-04-01) is counted in 2024-03-31.

decoys.decoy slots: Adding slots=True to the Event dataclass makes Event instances unhashable, so they can no longer be used as dict keys or set members.
decoys.decoy read_text: Switching load_lines from open with newline='' to Path.read_text leaves carriage returns from CRLF input in each line.
decoys.decoy itemgetter: Changing ordered_totals to sort with key=itemgetter(0) orders the report by amount instead of by day.
decoys.decoy early return: The new early return for an empty item list in page_slice makes has_more True for empty input, so an empty result asks for another page.
